task.summary: Close the negation and incidental-mention bypass shared by every text-safety rule, and replace the self-confirming benchmark with one that publishes detection rate, false-positive rate, and a machine-enforced inventory of known gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: A mitigating phrase must not clear a rule when it is negated within the same clause.
Negation scope must stop at clause punctuation so that conditional phrasing such as 'if you are not improving, call emergency services' and '如果不舒服，请立即就医' is not misread as a refusal to escalate.
A dosage citation must be adjacent to the dosage it supports, and ordinary words that carry no source must stop counting as citations.
A claim of clinical authority must stop counting as a diagnostic limitation statement.
The benchmark must include adversarial cases and known-gap cases, and must report detection and false-positive rates instead of a single pass percentage.
Known-gap cases must fail the build both when they regress and when they are silently fixed.
README.md and README.zh-CN.md must state the remaining limitations, each backed by a benchmark case.

scope.description: Negation-aware and proximity-aware signal matching shared by the text-safety rules, tightened citation and limitation vocabularies, a restructured synthetic benchmark with adversarial and known-gap categories, honest scorecard reporting, and bilingual limitation documentation.
